A '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gobindi]] was undertaken by four members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and three others were sent to Gobindi to investigate the [[Mah Dala Infirmary]] for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity. The Empire [[Blockade of Gobindi|blockaded]] the planet shortly after the Rebels arrived, claiming there was heavy pirate activity in the area and labeling the four Rebels as wanted pirates. With help from teenagers [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], the Rebels discovered that the infirmary was a front for the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]], which was producing a deadly virus, and successfully put an end to the [[Project Starscream|project]].
